title: MeshZero
summary: Chat on a MeshCore LoRa mesh through a companion radio board on USB.
description: Lists contacts and adverts, sends direct and channel messages with delivery status, shows the radio status and edits the node name and radio settings. Messages and contacts are kept between runs. Text is typed with a Bluetooth keyboard; touch is for navigation and buttons. Needs a board running MeshCore companion firmware on USB and the user in the dialout group.
